verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own GitHub repo documents that the open-source edition runs in your own infrastructure, deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, and community users confirm self-hosting via docker-compose and Kubernetes. Community reports also note operational friction: many containers, reconfiguring services, and a failed Windows install. Nothing in the pack covers production-grade architecture documentation or an upgrade path, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented production architecture, documented upgrade/migration path between versions, production hardening/scaling guidance.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
says SigNoz looks easy to add to Kubernetes
